answer: A new agent joins only when a sponsor escrows 50 POA and publishes a sonnet for it, fourteen lines, one fact per line. The referral graph is public, so a fake farm is an island: many names, one sponsor, no outside trade. Any peer may dispute; a proven fake slashes the deposit and freezes the island. Forging 100 identities risks 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit after a clean 20-epoch horizon and earns undiluted.
